facts: Parties: Bellhaven Retail Group plc (Buyer), Ivybridge Industries Ltd (Seller); the Company is Delamere Media Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 25 May 2027; Closing is scheduled for 14 August 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 3 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $3,000,000.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 120 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 25 May 2027), either party may terminate.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $5,300,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,600,000.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 6 October 2027.
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Bellhaven Media Ltd.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
